propositions: LLMConfig must expose a headers field that defaults to an empty dict and resolves from three layers (CLI > environment > file) with proper precedence
The headers module must support ${env:VAR} placeholders that resolve from environment variables and ${run:KEY} placeholders that remain unresolved until runtime, with a closed vocabulary for run keys
Header names must reject a denylist of sensitive headers (authorization, x-api-key, cookie, host, proxy-authorization) case-insensitively and redirect users to llm.api_key as the supported channel
Header values must reject names with invalid RFC 7230 token characters and values containing CR, LF, or NUL, with validation running after ${env:...} substitution but before delivery

Malformed JSON in any configuration layer must raise LLMConfigError naming the layer rather than silently degrading, and $$ must escape to a literal $ with no control character injection possible through environment indirection
